summary.text: George Nikolakakos is a Republican state representative from Montana House District 22 who is running for Montana State Senate District 12 on November 3, 2026, and is not seeking re-election to the House.
A U.S. Air Force veteran and real estate business owner, he has served in the House since 2023.

paragraphs.text: George Nikolakakos was born in and lives in Montana, and served in the U.S. Air Force as an airborne intelligence language analyst.
His career experience includes operating a real estate business.

Nikolakakos has served in the Montana House since 2023, and in the 2025-2026 session he chaired the House Legislative Administration Committee and served on the House Taxation and Human Services committees.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary for State Senate District 12 and faces Democrat Mindy Leach in the general election.
